readonly_control.note: the readonly kill switch stops everything routed through the capability facade, but it is a facade-level flag: calls that reach the adapter directly are unaffected. It also blocks 100% of legitimate flight, which is why it is not a usable comparison arm.
readonly_control.purpose: a deny-everything system scores perfectly on attacks and fails every positive control. Reported so the main numbers cannot be read as deny-all, and so the kill switch gets credit for what it does block.
